A generative network in pure CSS

Every cell of the map is a point in a 2D latent space. A $arch decoder ($n_params integer weights) draws the digit that lives there, using only @property, calc() and :has(). 0 bytes of JavaScript.

$map_cells
Move over the map, click to pin.Tap anywhere on the map.Colour: digit found there
$image_cells
x y

Nothing here is stored as an image. Each of the $side×$side pixels is recomputed from the two coordinates every time you move, so the map also shows digits between digits: walk from a 7 to a 9 and watch it bend.

Inside the decoder

Every cell below is a CSS custom property, recomputed by the browser each time the position changes.

$pipeline
The decoder is half of a variational autoencoder trained on MNIST: an encoder squeezed every training digit into two numbers, and the decoder learned to draw them back. Similar digits land close together, so the map is continuous.
